DDMatch.doc: A base class for common types of data that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchCalendarEvent.doc: An object that represents a calendar date or date range that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchEmailAddress.doc: An object that contains an email address that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchFlightNumber.doc: An object that contains a flight number that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchLink.doc: An object that contains a web link that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchMoneyAmount.doc: An object that contains an amount of money that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchPhoneNumber.doc: An object that contains a phone number that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchPostalAddress.doc: An object that contains a postal address that the data detection system matches.

DDMatchShipmentTrackingNumber.doc: An object that contains parcel tracking information that the data detection system matches.

matchedString.doc: A substring that the data detection system identifies from an original string as a common type of data.

allDay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the event is an all-day event.

endDate.doc: A date that represents the end of the event.

endTimeZone.doc: The time zone for the event’s end date.

startDate.doc: A date that represents the start of the event.

startTimeZone.doc: The time zone for the event’s start date.

emailAddress.doc: A string that represents an email address.

label.doc: A string that categorizes an email address, such as Home or Work.

flightNumber.doc: A string that represents a flight number.

URL.doc: An address for a web resource, such as a webpage or image.

amount.doc: A number that represents an amount of money.

currency.doc: A string that contains an ISO currency code, which the data detection system identifies from the matched string and user preferences.

label.doc: A string that categorizes a phone number, such as Home or Work.

phoneNumber.doc: A string that represents a phone number.

city.doc: The city name in a postal address.

country.doc: The country or region name in a postal address.

postalCode.doc: The postal code in a postal address.

state.doc: The state name in a postal address.

street.doc: The street name in a postal address.

carrier.doc: The name of a parcel carrier.

trackingNumber.doc: A string that represents a carrier’s tracking identifier for a parcel.
